from openpyxl import load_workbook
from openpyxl.styles import PatternFill
from pathlib import Path

input_path = Path("/mnt/data/spreadsheet/494-13/1_494-13_input.xlsx")
output_path = Path("/mnt/data/outputs/494-13_0_b613508d/1_494-13_output.xlsx")

wb = load_workbook(input_path)
ws = wb["Sheet1"]

# Exact answer range: D1:E22.  Only fills in this range are modified.
start_row, end_row = 1, 22

yellow = PatternFill(fill_type="solid", fgColor="FFFFFF00")  # non-matching pair
red = PatternFill(fill_type="solid", fgColor="FFFF0000")     # no corresponding key/pair
nofill = PatternFill(fill_type=None)

# Build lookup from the first pair of columns (A:B)
# key = «redacted» in A, associated values = values in B
lookup = {}
pair_set = set()
for r in range(start_row, end_row + 1):
    a = ws.cell(r, 1).value
    b = ws.cell(r, 2).value
    if a is None:
        continue
    lookup.setdefault(a, set()).add(b)
    pair_set.add((a, b))

# Highlight the second pair of columns (D:E)
for r in range(start_row, end_row + 1):
    d_cell = ws.cell(r, 4)
    e_cell = ws.cell(r, 5)
    d = d_cell.value
    e = e_cell.value

    # Clear any previous fills inside the permitted output range first.
    d_cell.fill = nofill
    e_cell.fill = nofill

    if d is None and e is None:
        continue

    if d not in lookup:
        # D has no corresponding item in column A, so the D:E pair has no pair.
        d_cell.fill = red
        e_cell.fill = red
    elif e not in lookup[d]:
        # D exists in A, but its paired value in E does not match the paired value in B.
        d_cell.fill = yellow
        e_cell.fill = yellow

output_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
wb.save(output_path)

# Verification printout for the exact edited range.
check_wb = load_workbook(output_path)
check_ws = check_wb["Sheet1"]
for r in range(start_row, end_row + 1):
    vals = (check_ws.cell(r, 4).value, check_ws.cell(r, 5).value)
    fills = (check_ws.cell(r, 4).fill.fgColor.rgb, check_ws.cell(r, 5).fill.fgColor.rgb)
    print(f"D{r}:E{r}", vals, fills)
